_comment: A waiver records a finding that is REAL and OWNED but not yet fixed, or one that
another in-flight PR owns. Each must name owner, reason, gate and -- for checks
whose identity includes a target -- target; dead-code waivers additionally require
literalContains so they cannot transfer between assertions.
Waivers are self-expiring: once the finding disappears the check reports
'stale-waiver' and fails CI until the entry is deleted.
Do NOT add a waiver to make a real violation disappear. Fix it, or declare it here
with an owner and an honest reason.

waivers.reason: REAL FINDING, awaiting fix (retrospective-2 RC-3). Surfaced by this PR's own fix for negative shell targets -- the guard is `if grep -qF "events.registered(...)" src/contexts/AuthContext.jsx; then fail; fi`, a negative claim about a file that never executes, which the checker previously could not see. The invariant (no duplicate signup hook in the email registration path) belongs to the live analytics surface and the funnel lane (#1136); retargeting it is their call, not this PR's. Note this same dead file is also read by tests/funnel-analytics-contract.test.mjs:62, which would fail with ENOENT if the file were deleted.
